skill.name: weibo-content-research
skill.description: Fetch current Weibo hot searches and keyword results through SocialDataX. Organize post links and engagement metrics for content planning and competitor research.
skill.summary: Summarize Weibo hot searches and compare relevant posts with source links.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts reflect Markdown formatting, vendor links, or readable Chinese text, not shell substitution or obfuscation. The unpinned SocialDataX CLI runs with access to API credentials, and the search example lacks guidance for passing untrusted arguments safely. No evidence of credential exfiltration or an attempt to override the audit was found.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples run a mutable npm release without an installation prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before the first CLI launch, pin an audited version, and verify package integrity before running it.

remediation.issue: The CLI reads environment credentials and can persist an API key in a home-directory file.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer managed secret storage and a dedicated credential scope. Verify access controls where file storage remains and keep credentials out of agent-visible diagnostics.

remediation.issue: The examples do not define how to pass keywords and pagination tokens safely.
remediation.suggestion: Pass untrusted values as separate arguments without invoking a shell. Keep pagination tokens opaque and treat returned values as data.

content.value_statement: Weibo rankings and keyword results answer different research questions. Review both with SocialDataX and keep post evidence separate from your conclusions.
actual_capabilities: Fetch the current Weibo hot-search list without a keyword.
Find Weibo posts by keyword and limit a CLI search by pages or result count.
Summarize visible rankings and popularity signals separately from keyword matches.
Retain available post links, IDs, author details, engagement metrics, and publication times for verification.
Identify incomplete CLI results and resume the same query within its original limits when a continuation token is available.
limitations: Live data requires an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or an existing authenticated MCP connection. Requests may consume service credits.
Keyword results are samples, not an exhaustive list of Weibo posts. The search has no stable endpoint for fetching every result.
Hot-search rankings reflect the current list, not historical trends or representative audience sentiment.
The Weibo operations do not post, like, comment, or change an account.

use_cases.title: Review the Daily Hot List
use_cases.description: Summarize current topics and their ranking signals before choosing what to cover.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor Messaging
use_cases.description: Compare how two brands discuss a shared topic. Keep post links and visible engagement metrics with each example.

use_cases.title: Find Angles for a New Post
use_cases.description: Sample posts on a planned topic. Use recurring questions or themes to choose an angle for further research.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Hot Searches
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current Weibo hot searches. Summarize the top five topics and include their ranks and any available popularity signals.

prompt_templates.title: Sample Posts by Keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo for [keyword]. Use one page and summarize the main themes. Include links and publication times when available.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Gather a small set of posts.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo for [brand A] and [brand B] with [topic]. Use one page per search. Compare recurring themes and cite examples for each brand.

prompt_templates.title: Cross-Check a Trend
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the current hot list and search for [topic] with a limit of two pages and ten posts. Report ranking signals and post evidence separately. Label any incomplete results and suggest one follow-up question.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Compare sources within explicit limits.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Check current hot searches for public transport topics.
output: One public transport topic appeared on the sampled list. Its rank shows current visibility, not sustained interest.
Follow-up: Search for the transit line name to see which service questions appear in posts.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Compare two coffee brands in one page of results per brand.
output: Brand A posts in the sample emphasized seasonal drinks. Brand B posts emphasized store openings.
Keep the source link and publication time with each cited post. The sample does not show which brand received more attention overall.

best_practices: Start with a narrow keyword and one page. Expand only when the initial sample does not answer the question.
Keep available links and timestamps. Separate observed results from your interpretation.
Use an approved connection and keep API keys out of chat, prompts, and shared logs.
anti_patterns: Treating a current hot-search rank as proof of long-term popularity or broad public opinion.
Sending confidential search terms to SocialDataX without approval.
Restarting a partial search from page one and repeating paid requests.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: CLI access needs a SocialDataX API key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection uses its own credentials and does not require local CLI setup.

faq.question: Do hot searches need a keyword?
faq.answer: No. The hot-search tool retrieves the current list. Use post search when you want results for one keyword.

faq.question: What can I use to verify a result?
faq.answer: Ask for available post links, IDs, authors, publication times, and engagement metrics.

faq.question: Can I collect every matching post?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable boundary for complete retrieval. Use explicit page or result limits for a defined sample.

faq.question: What happens if a request runs out of credits?
faq.answer: The workflow stops retrying and reports the balance issue. An incomplete search can resume after resolution when a continuation token is available.

faq.question: Can this skill publish or interact with posts?
faq.answer: No. Its Weibo operations only retrieve data. They do not post, like, comment, or modify an account.
